lines.text: You were with Itadori earlier, weren't you? (Bashful)
lines.de: You were with Itadori earlier, weren't you? (Bashful)

lines.text: Welcome! (Friendly) (VFX: 10% Space, 3% Echo) (Lower your mic volume)
lines.de: Welcome! (Friendly) (VFX: 10% Space, 3% Echo) (Lower your mic volume)

lines.text: This' is what I looked like at our middle school graduation ceremony... (Explanatory) (' means emphasis)
lines.de: This' is what I looked like at our middle school graduation ceremony... (Explanatory) (' means emphasis)

lines.text: Huh, 'seriously'? That was only six 'months' ago! (Astonished/amazed) (' means emphasis)
lines.de: Huh, 'seriously'? That was only six 'months' ago! (Astonished/amazed) (' means emphasis)

lines.text: Well yeah- I guess I've grown about 15 centimeters since graduation day. (Bashful)
lines.de: Well yeah- I guess I've grown about 15 centimeters since graduation day. (Bashful)

lines.text: Plus, I guess the combination of the stress of moving to Tokyo and changing environments...!
lines.de: Plus, I guess the combination of the stress of moving to Tokyo and changing environments...!

lines.text: On graduation day, I worked up the courage to ask if he'd take a photo with me...
lines.de: On graduation day, I worked up the courage to ask if he'd take a photo with me...

lines.text: Actually', what I wanted was to ask for his phone number. (Regretful)
lines.de: Actually', what I wanted was to ask for his phone number. (Regretful)

lines.text: But I already knew that we were moving to Tokyo. (Disappointed)
lines.de: But I already knew that we were moving to Tokyo. (Disappointed)

lines.text: So when I saw Itadori with you 'earlier'...
lines.de: So when I saw Itadori with you 'earlier'...

lines.text: I thought, 'maybe' with the way I look 'now'... I might- (Hopeful)
lines.de: I thought, 'maybe' with the way I look 'now'... I might- (Hopeful)

lines.text: Wait... Yuko- you mean that- (Caught on)
lines.de: Wait... Yuko- you mean that- (Caught on)

lines.text: Yes, that's what I mean- it's like 'THAT'...! (Affirmative)
lines.de: Yes, that's what I mean- it's like 'THAT'...! (Affirmative)

lines.text: Is Fushiguro still riding with you? (Disingenuous)
lines.de: Is Fushiguro still riding with you? (Disingenuous)

lines.text: I just dropped you a location PIN to the restaurant I'm at- Could you turn around and bring him here? (Disingenuous)
lines.de: I just dropped you a location PIN to the restaurant I'm at- Could you turn around and bring him here? (Disingenuous)

lines.text: Someone' who knows Itadori pretty well is on his way here 'right' now. (Proud)
lines.de: Someone' who knows Itadori pretty well is on his way here 'right' now. (Proud)

lines.text: I think we should talk to 'him' about it first.
lines.de: I think we should talk to 'him' about it first.

lines.text: Well'... if you're 'also' interested in Itadori, then-
lines.de: Well'... if you're 'also' interested in Itadori, then-

lines.text: If hell froze over and danced the lambada... (Annoyed)
lines.de: If hell froze over and danced the lambada... (Annoyed)

lines.text: I just got the 'weirdest' feeling in my 'chest'... (Perplexed) (VFX: 30% Space, 10% Echo)
lines.de: I just got the 'weirdest' feeling in my 'chest'... (Perplexed) (VFX: 30% Space, 10% Echo)

lines.text: Did 'my' heart skip a beat...? (Concerned) (VFX: 30% Space, 10% Echo)
lines.de: Did 'my' heart skip a beat...? (Concerned) (VFX: 30% Space, 10% Echo)

lines.text: Oh 'hey' there, Fushiguro... does Itadori have a girlfriend? (Feigning ignorance)
lines.de: Oh 'hey' there, Fushiguro... does Itadori have a girlfriend? (Feigning ignorance)

lines.text: She knows Itadori from middle school if you 'know-what-I-mean'... (Hinting)
lines.de: She knows Itadori from middle school if you 'know-what-I-mean'... (Hinting)

lines.text: Oh, so it's like 'THAT', huh? (Excited, surprised)
lines.de: Oh, so it's like 'THAT', huh? (Excited, surprised)

lines.text: When he had to transfer to Tokyo, he... didn't seem particularly upset about it. (Explanatory)
lines.de: When he had to transfer to Tokyo, he... didn't seem particularly upset about it. (Explanatory)

lines.text: He-also' has a pin-up poster hanging in his room.
lines.de: He-also' has a pin-up poster hanging in his room.

lines.text: Anyone-with-a 'girlfriend' wouldn't have something like 'that' hanging up... (Disapproving)
lines.de: Anyone-with-a 'girlfriend' wouldn't have something like 'that' hanging up... (Disapproving)

lines.text: Are you the type to drink coffee black only when women are around s'you can show off...? (Concerned disapproval)
lines.de: Are you the type to drink coffee black only when women are around s'you can show off...? (Concerned disapproval)

lines.text: Did'ya 'call-me-here' to ask me about this or to ridicule me? (Annoyed)
lines.de: Did'ya 'call-me-here' to ask me about this or to ridicule me? (Annoyed)

lines.text: I always drink it black, 'SO' there... (Defensive)
lines.de: I always drink it black, 'SO' there... (Defensive)

lines.text: By the way, do you 'happen' to know what his 'type' is-? (Curious)
lines.de: By the way, do you 'happen' to know what his 'type' is-? (Curious)

lines.text: I 'think' he might've mentioned that he likes 'tall' girls.
lines.de: I 'think' he might've mentioned that he likes 'tall' girls.

lines.text: I'll' text Itadori 'now'-! Are you okay with that, Yuko? (Pumped)
lines.de: I'll' text Itadori 'now'-! Are you okay with that, Yuko? (Pumped)

lines.text: Finding' a cash exchange was a pain, so I traded in for prizes instead. (Background) (Lower your mic volume)
lines.de: Finding' a cash exchange was a pain, so I traded in for prizes instead. (Background) (Lower your mic volume)

lines.text: He 'definitely won't recognize her after he 'changed' so much! (Screwed)
lines.de: He 'definitely won't recognize her after he 'changed' so much! (Screwed)

lines.text: That's the 'number-one' line you don't wanna hear when reuniting with the guy from 'MIDDLE' school who you 'like' 'LIKE THAT'! (Severely worried) (VFX: 30% Space, 10% Echo)
lines.de: That's the 'number-one' line you don't wanna hear when reuniting with the guy from 'MIDDLE' school who you 'like' 'LIKE THAT'! (Severely worried) (VFX: 30% Space, 10% Echo)

lines.text: Itadori-! This girl is-! (Thinking she messed up)
lines.de: Itadori-! This girl is-! (Thinking she messed up)

lines.text: Wait a second- You're Ozawa! What're you doing here? (Pleasantly surprised)
lines.de: Wait a second- You're Ozawa! What're you doing here? (Pleasantly surprised)

lines.text: *Inhale, then exhale into a short sigh*
lines.de: *Inhale, then exhale into a short sigh*

lines.text: I gave his cell-number to her... they should be okay. (Positive affirmation)
lines.de: I gave his cell-number to her... they should be okay. (Positive affirmation)

lines.text: But more importantly, I've 'realized' my own 'feelings', Fushiguro... (Stuck-up)
lines.de: But more importantly, I've 'realized' my own 'feelings', Fushiguro... (Stuck-up)

lines.text: The thought that Itadori might land a girlfriend before I'm able to get a boyfriend 'REALLY' pisses me off to 'no-end'. (Envious, annoyed)
lines.de: The thought that Itadori might land a girlfriend before I'm able to get a boyfriend 'REALLY' pisses me off to 'no-end'. (Envious, annoyed)

lines.text: You need to walk behind me. (Stern)
lines.de: You need to walk behind me. (Stern)

lines.text: Huh-? You're-kiddin'. What're-you talking about? (Offended confusion)
lines.de: Huh-? You're-kiddin'. What're-you talking about? (Offended confusion)

lines.text: I know you're the type of gentleman who would feel bad making a lady carry them... (Stuck-up)
lines.de: I know you're the type of gentleman who would feel bad making a lady carry them... (Stuck-up)

lines.text: Huh-? Hey, hold on, don't take my 'stuff' with you! (Surprised)
lines.de: Huh-? Hey, hold on, don't take my 'stuff' with you! (Surprised)

lines.text: There's 'NO' way I'm watching some 'wormo' man! (Pissy)
lines.de: There's 'NO' way I'm watching some 'wormo' man! (Pissy)

lines.text: Fushiguro-! You want some popcorn-? Caramel flavor... right? (Thoughtful)
lines.de: Fushiguro-! You want some popcorn-? Caramel flavor... right? (Thoughtful)

lines.text: Just don't tell me the 'plot'- if we're gonna see 'wormo man'... (annoyed)
lines.de: Just don't tell me the 'plot'- if we're gonna see 'wormo man'... (annoyed)

lines.text: I 'told' you, it's 'HUMAN' earth worm 'FOUR'! (Annoyed affirmation)
lines.de: I 'told' you, it's 'HUMAN' earth worm 'FOUR'! (Annoyed affirmation)
